policies.title: Stop the boats
policies.statement: Deploy the armed forces to intercept migrant boats in the English Channel and turn back or stop illegal crossings before they land.

policies.title: Mass deportation programme
policies.statement: Leave the European Convention on Human Rights and run a five-year programme to identify, detain and deport people with no right to remain, using up to five flights a day.

policies.title: Scrap indefinite leave to remain
policies.statement: End existing long-term visa routes and replace them with five-year renewable visas that require a higher salary and fluent English.

policies.title: Scrap Net Zero policies
policies.statement: Scrap Net Zero policies, expand domestic energy production including North Sea oil and gas, and cut household energy bills.

policies.title: Make work pay
policies.statement: Cut taxes on workers' pay and restructure the welfare system so that being in work always pays more than claiming benefits.

policies.title: Restore British sovereignty
policies.statement: Ensure British law and courts take precedence over foreign courts and international institutions in domestic decision-making.
